Jordan (Partnerships): Hey team — quick: we need a short partner-facing checklist for uploading marketplace compliance bundles (SOC, pentest, questionnaires). Keep it 3 bullets + presign example.
Nina (Security): 3 bullets: 1) Redact direct identifiers (SSNs, full credit cards) or replace with tokens (e.g., XXX-XX-1234). 2) Mark NDA material in metadata field "nda":true and contact security for transfer. 3) Provide artifact-metadata.json with vendor, artifact_type, scan_date, contact_email.
Mei (SI): Partners want a filename pattern so automation works. Recommend: vendor-artifacttype-YYYYMMDD.zip
Carl (Ops): Presign endpoint: https://evidence.redwood.ai/presign. Curl example: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"key":"acme-pen-2025-20250130.zip","contentType":"application/zip","ttl":86400}' https://evidence.redwood.ai/presign
Nina (Security): Retention and access: default retention 5y for SOC/pen; NDA flagged -> restrict access to security+partnerships until cleared. Manual QA on one sample per partner.
Mei (SI): I'll run a dry-run with one partner this week. Please watch for infra-bot events.
infra-bot: dry-run received: acme-sample-20250130.zip uploaded via presign, size=2.1MB, sha256=deadbeef, ts=1733333350
Jordan (Partnerships): Thanks — I'll turn this into a one-page quickcard and send to partners channel. Action items: Mei run dry-run (due 1733410000), Nina QA, Carl confirm presign TTL. :white_check_mark:
